name: aws-sso-status
title: AWS SSO Status
description: Check AWS IAM Identity Center credentials and their remaining lifetime from Raycast and your menu bar.
author: leo66

commands.name: aws-sso-status
commands.title: AWS SSO Status
commands.description: View IAM Identity Center profiles, check credentials, and sign in

commands.name: aws-sso-menu-bar
commands.title: AWS SSO Menu Bar
commands.description: Monitor AWS credential status and remaining lifetime in the menu bar

commands.name: aws-sso-sign-in
commands.title: AWS SSO Login
commands.description: Quickly sign in with the primary SSO profile or an optional profile name

commands.name: diagnostics
commands.title: AWS SSO Diagnostics
commands.description: Inspect local AWS config path, CLI installation, and profile discovery without exposing credentials

preferences.name: primaryProfile
preferences.title: Primary Profile
preferences.description: Leave empty to select default, or the first profile alphabetically. Must match the profile filter.

preferences.name: profileFilter
preferences.title: Profile Filter
preferences.description: Comma-separated profile names, such as dev,production. Leave empty to show all SSO profiles.

preferences.name: threshold
preferences.title: Expiring Soon Threshold
preferences.description: Warn when the resolved credentials have this much time remaining.

preferences.name: menuBarStyle
preferences.title: Menu Bar Style
preferences.description: Show only remaining time, or a check/cross symbol. Profile details stay in the dropdown.

preferences.name: awsCliPath
preferences.title: AWS CLI Path
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to aws for custom installations. Otherwise searches PATH and standard macOS locations.

preferences.name: notifyOnSignOut
preferences.title: Sign-In Reminder
preferences.label: Notify when an active SSO session needs sign-in
preferences.description: Show one Raycast Toast/HUD per sign-out episode, after a previously successful check. No repeated reminders. Disabled by default.
